mentions.storyTitle: Most images of black holes are illustrations. Here’s what our telescopes capture
mentions.text: … ple of a cognitive metaphor. Note also that the best way to demonstrate the intuitive effect of gravity is to show how it acts like a hole. A black hole visualized the same way is a very, very deep pit. https://youtu.be/MTY1Kje0yLg
